The state adds an unusually severe facility ban covering airports, civil and criminal penalties, and private bounty-style lawsuits, alongside invalidated state IDs. These operative, visitor-facing exposures compound the restrictive national framework.

The national document and entry regime still creates substantial risk. State courts have repeatedly blocked restrictive laws, including facility and care bans, and upheld document relief; protections are imperfect, and later legislation and flag restrictions leave uncertainty.
